Hello, my friend! I am Ananse. Shapes do not only live on the blackboard.
Shapes are all around us. Come outside and look with me.
The face of the clock is a circle.
Look at the roof of this house.
The door is a rectangle. Two long sides and two short sides.
Here are four more things you already know.
Which one is a circle? The coin!
Which one is a square? The biscuit tin!
Which one is a triangle? The slice of watermelon!
Which one is a rectangle? The bank note!
They are hiding inside almost everything around you.
Look for them on your way home today.
